description.value:
You served with a settlement's watch or a similar body responsible for keeping the peace — not walking a beat so much as picking up the pieces afterward, tracing a crime back to whoever committed it. Few communities can spare more than one or two people with that particular knack, and you were one of them.

The discipline of that service stayed with you: a rigid sense of duty, a hard-won read on local law and local criminals alike, and more than a few unresolved cases you still think about.

system.equipment: A uniform in the style of your former unit indicating your rank, a horn with which to summon help, a set of binders, and a pouch containing 100 credits.
